title: Square Mile
subtitle: Test your understanding of Square Mile — London's Tartarian aetheric circuitboard and its inversion into a financial control center after 1666.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Recognizing currency as an inverted stand-in for suppressed aetheric current cuts the story of manufactured scarcity. The Population Math Discrepancy and the falsified street maps break reliance on the freemasonic timeline.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Square Mile” refers to the 1.12-square-mile central district of London, originally an engineered Tartarian wireless power grid and aetheric node retrofitted into a global financial center.

options.label: A

options.rationale: True — the report defines “Square Mile” this way.

options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “Square Mile” as: The 1.12-square-mile central district of London, originally an engineered Tartarian wireless power grid and aetheric node retrofitted into a global financial center.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Square Mile”.
